name: @cveil/web
description: Cveil dashboard UI — bundled for CDN delivery

scripts.build:copy: vite build && cp dist/cveil-web.iife.js ../cveil-rest-api/src/main/resources/META-INF/resources/js/cveil-web.iife.js && cp dist/cveil-web.css ../cveil-rest-api/src/main/resources/META-INF/resources/css/cveil-web.css
scripts.build:wasm: cd ../crates && cargo build -p cveil-sdk-core --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --features browser --release && mkdir -p ../sdks/cveil-sdk-js/wasm/browser && cp target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/cveil_sdk_core.wasm ../sdks/cveil-sdk-js/wasm/browser/ && cp target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/cveil_sdk_core.wasm ../cveil-rest-api/src/main/resources/META-INF/resources/wasm/
